meta.source: Cooked app screens, October 2026: sage for actions, bronze only for food to use soon. Type: Alumni Sans + Albert Sans + Caveat on notes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background on every screen. Cooked is white-first; color lives in the sticky notes, not the ground.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Secondary pills, the segmented switch track, steppers and unpicked filter pills. No border, no shadow.

tokens.name: surface-tag
tokens.usage: Rare small counters. Location names on rows are plain ink-muted text, not tags.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px outline on the search field, fields, the account button, the tab island and the undo bar.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Dividers between list rows; empty track of the progress bar.

tokens.name: check-border
tokens.usage: Unchecked checkbox outline and dashed add-item box.

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Outline of things you fill in or tick: unchecked checkbox, radio, dashed add box, text fields and the search field. 3.4:1 on surface, the 3:1 non-text minimum. Use line for dividers and the island.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings and default icon color. 17.6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: row notes, tag text, helper copy. 5.2:1 on surface — safe for small text.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and non-essential hints only. 3.4:1 on surface: FLAGGED. Use ink-muted for small text that matters.

tokens.name: ink-off
tokens.usage: Crossed-out done items only. 2.6:1 on surface: FLAGGED.

tokens.name: tab-mark
tokens.usage: The short grey underscore under the active tab icon in the island.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Checkmark inside a checked box (on sage-ink).

tokens.name: sage-ink
tokens.usage: Links, icons inside pills, the checked checkbox, an on switch, focused field borders and Undo. 6.4:1 on surface.

tokens.name: sage-ink-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for sage-ink links.

tokens.name: progress
tokens.usage: To Buy progress bar fill on a line-soft track.

tokens.name: error-ink
tokens.usage: Errors (a wrong code, an unusable field) and destructive text buttons (Delete account, Leave this kitchen). Never a fill. 6.1:1 on surface.

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: Underline on the handwritten 'use soon' flag on a sticky note. Nothing else.

tokens.name: bronze-ink
tokens.usage: Food that needs using soon: the use-soon icon, 'Best by tomorrow' lines and the note flag. 6.0:1 on surface. Never for links or buttons.

tokens.name: cornsilk
tokens.usage: Sticky note paper: Fridge. Also the picked Fridge tab in Kitchen and the Tonight note.

tokens.name: papaya
tokens.usage: Sticky note paper: Pantry. Also the picked Pantry tab.

tokens.name: beige
tokens.usage: Sticky note paper: Freezer. Also the picked Freezer tab and a picked choice card in onboarding.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: The primary button fill (one per screen, with ink text), a picked filter pill and the picked To Buy tab. 12:1 with ink text.

tokens.name: note-ink
tokens.usage: Handwritten text on every sticky note. 12:1 or better on all four papers.

tokens.name: note-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Second line on a sticky note (counts like '12 items'). 7:1 or better on all four papers.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Screen title, top left. One per screen. Bold, tall and condensed.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section headings, left-aligned, sentence case. Semibold (600), a step below the bold (700) screen title. No underline.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: List rows, inputs, search text, helper paragraphs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines under a section title; progress counts.

styles.name: note-title
styles.usage: Sticky note name. Only on sticky notes.

styles.name: note-body
styles.usage: Sticky note count or short status.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Island inner padding; tight icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in pills; title-to-meta gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between paired pills; gap inside a section.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card side padding; gap from section title to its content.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Gap between sections, and the minimum gap between a bold title and the first section title.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Island distance from the bottom edge.

tokens.name: radius-note
tokens.usage: Sticky note corners (the bottom-right corner uses radius-card for the curl).

tokens.name: radius-check
tokens.usage: Rounded-square checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Square icon buttons (account).

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Search field.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners use 28px) and the rare grouped card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, filter pills, the switch, steppers, the tab island and the undo bar.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Rarely needed now; fields and lists are flat with a 1px line.

tokens.name: shadow-island
tokens.usage: The floating tab island and the undo bar.

tokens.name: shadow-note
tokens.usage: Sticky notes: a tight contact shadow plus a lifted drop.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap area for anything you can tap. A smaller drawn control (24px checkbox, 36px pill) gets a 44px hit area around it.

tokens.name: screen-width
tokens.usage: Design frame width (iPhone).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Action pills on Home; 52px for the full-width primary button at the bottom of a screen.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Search field.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Minimum list row height (To Buy, Kitchen, Check items).

tokens.name: note-height
tokens.usage: Sticky note height in the three-note kitchen row on Home.

tokens.name: island-width
tokens.usage: Tab island width, centered.

tokens.name: island-height
tokens.usage: Tab island height.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size: tab island, buttons, rows.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside pills and next to captions.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke width for every icon at 24px; use 2 at 18px and below.
